csv_project_name: AE for Rocky Mount North Main Corridor BDR
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Rocky Mount, Virginia ( Town or Rocky Mount ) is soliciting electronic proposals from qualified Architectural/Engineering firms ( A/E firm or firm ) to provide professional design, engineering, bidding, and construction administration services for the North Main Corridor Business District Revitalization Project. The implementation project includes coordinated revitalization activities intended to improve the corridor through: fa ade improvements, initial streetscape improvements, pedestrian safety enhancements, wayfinding installation, corridor placemaking, industrial heritage mural coordination, and related infrastructure coordination.
